_comment: Reads a snapshot from the active Python component.

objective.name: active.snapshot
objective.description: Returns the current active runtime snapshot

#root.role: Read the current snapshot of the active background component inside the wrapper runtime.

transformation_contract.morphing: A snapshot request becomes an explicit view of the current active wrapper component state.
invariants: active.snapshot must remain bounded by its declared inputs, outputs, and effects.
Internal implementation strategy may vary, but the declared contract surface must remain stable.
success: active.snapshot returns payload and matter effects consistent with the declared outputs when it succeeds.
Successful execution preserves the semantic change described by morphing.
failure: active.snapshot fails when required inputs or matter contracts are not satisfied.
The capacity fails when the underlying runtime or wrapper cannot satisfy the declared contract.
notes: This contract constrains expected behavior and observable effects, not the internal implementation decomposition.
Humans and LLMs should interpret the capacity through the declared interface and semantic guarantees first.
